authority: OMG SysML 2.0 Part 1 formal/26-03-02, §7.26, §8.2.3 and §9.2.20; local runtime support remains separately bounded
boundary: A mapping of view meaning to presentation. Not a declaration of full SysML graphical-notation or language conformance.

limits: Bounded source concern/case, direct definition/usage typing, requirements and variation/selection profiles. Not every specialization, multiplicity, nested requirement or configuration constraint is rendered.

Direct part.port binary interconnections; local calculation inputs/results, explicit values and selected Boolean constraints. Arbitrary solver execution and general nested port chains are unsupported.

Local actions, parameters, explicit control/item flows, fork/join and decision/merge nodes. General loops, performer lanes, nested call expansion and all send/accept semantics are not qualified. Unsupported subtypes fail closed.

Flat state summaries plus source-owned nested/concurrent states, declared entry, trigger/guard/effect and entry/do/exit inspection. Unknown concurrency or missing condition fields are refused. No inferred preferred state or outcome.

Local feature lifelines, event occurrences, explicitly typed messages, self-messages and acyclic precedence. Nested interactions and arbitrary message payload semantics are not qualified. Vertical ranks are not elapsed time or a total order.
Positive rectangular-cuboid dimensions with supported length units. Local isometric shape envelopes only; assembly frames, transforms, clearances, other solids and CAD operations are not implemented.

Exact typed relationship matrices, planned verification coverage, bounded scalar arithmetic for analysis cases and declared duration budgets. No executed verification result or measured timing is inferred.
Indented searchable source-owned namespace membership, with definition/usage labels. Imported library members and occurrence feature expansion are deliberately outside this profile.
Selected part occurrence/composition scope; not identical to model membership.
Acyclic explicitly directed transfer graph, two to five presentation columns. Placement implies neither execution order nor measured timing.
Explicit configured duration/start features in supported units only. No measured or calendar history extraction.
UML class and database ER semantics are not substitutes for SysML definition/usage or feature typing.
